name: Metabutoxycaine
summary: Metabutoxycaine, marketed under the trade name Primacaine, is a local anesthetic. It is used in dentistry.S. patent number 2,882,296.

body.says: Lasts for at least 12 hours after injection.

uses.text: Metabutoxycaine, marketed under the trade name Primacaine, is a local anesthetic.

summaryZh: 美布卡因是一種含氮有機化合物，分子式C17H28N2O3，在牙醫學中用作局部麻醉藥。
summaryZhHans: 美布卡因是一种含氮有机化合物，分子式C17H28N2O3，在牙医学中用作局部麻醉药。

pharmacology.en: Like other local anaesthetics, it blocks sodium channels in nerves, stopping pain signals from travelling along them.
pharmacology.zh: 和其他局部麻醉劑一樣，它會阻斷神經的鈉離子通道，讓疼痛訊號無法沿神經傳遞。
pharmacology.zhHans: 和其他局部麻醉剂一样，它会阻断神经的钠离子信道，让疼痛信号无法沿神经传递。

sideEffects.en: It can cause numbness beyond the intended area and, rarely, allergic reactions. Like other local anaesthetics, too much reaching the bloodstream can cause seizures and dangerous heart problems.
sideEffects.zh: 它可能使預定範圍以外的部位麻木，罕見時會引起過敏反應。和其他局部麻醉劑一樣，過多進入血液可能造成癲癇發作與危險的心臟問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它可能使预定范围以外的部位麻木，罕见时会引起过敏反应。和其他局部麻醉剂一样，过多进入血液可能造成癫痫发作与危险的心脏问题。

fact.en: Sold as Primacaine for dental numbing, metabutoxycaine is an ester of an aminobenzoic acid, the same basic design as procaine, the anaesthetic sold as Novocaine.
fact.zh: Metabutoxycaine 以 Primacaine 之名用於牙科麻醉，它是胺基苯甲酸的酯，與以 Novocaine 販售的普魯卡因採用相同的基本設計。
fact.zhHans: Metabutoxycaine 以 Primacaine 之名用于牙科麻醉，它是胺基苯甲酸的酯，与以 Novocaine 贩售的普鲁卡因采用相同的基本设计。
